title: Access lattice and cross-tenant privilege guardrails and audit contract
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Current RBAC surface models permissions as flat role assignments and some ad-hoc tenant/organization scoping. For RBAC v2 we need a composable access lattice that supports: (1) resource hierarchies (org > project > model > deployment), (2) explicit scopes and sealed scope boundaries, (3) permission derivation rules (allow/deny precedence, implicit grants), (4) cross-tenant delegation patterns for shared resources, and (5) structured audit mapping for compliance.

Goals:
- Define an access lattice that permits deterministic permission resolution (no ambiguous implicit grants).
- Define scope sealing semantics so certain resources can opt-out of inheritance (e.g., sensitive deployments).
- Produce a compact permissions matrix (actions x resource-types) that maps to Redwood API routes and Console controls.
- Specify how SSO/SAML assertions map to role attributes and scoped claims (group-to-role mappings, org-claim enforcement).
- Tight integration points for audit logging: canonical event shape, privilege-change events, and resolution trace that can be emitted to audit sink (CloudWatch/BigQuery).
- Admin controls: emergency breakglass, least-privilege onboarding flows, time-bound elevated sessions, and canary migration plan for tenants currently on RBAC v1.

Deliverables:
- Formal spec (Confluence) with diagrams showing lattice joins, inheritance examples, and deny/allow evaluation order.
- Permissions matrix CSV mapping Redwood API endpoints to atomic actions.
- Migration checklist for existing role mappings and a staged rollout strategy.
- JSON schema for audit resolution traces and example logs.
- POC implementation hooks in the role-resolver service and unit test suite.

Acceptance criteria:
- Spec reviewed and approved by Security and Platform leads.
- Implementation PR passes e2e permission resolution tests and emits resolution trace in audit logs.
- Migration runbook validated on two pilot tenants with no customer-visible regressions.

2025-09-24 - Design review: Security requested explicit deny precedence for 'safety' actions (e.g., export_data) and tracing of deny root cause. Agreed to include a resolution trace in audit logs that records matched bindings and evaluation order.

2025-09-30 - PM feedback (Anya Patel): ensure SSO mapping supports both group-based and attribute-based claims; add mapping examples for Okta and Azure AD. Added to spec: 'saml.groups' -> role bindings and 'saml.org_id' enforcement.

2025-10-01 - Engineering note: prototype role-resolver API (PR #7831) added 3 endpoints: /resolve, /simulate, /graph. /simulate will be used for migration dry-runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7831
2025-10-02 - Security review: requested explicit handling for orphaned grants when tenant is archived; we will auto-revoke non-admin grants after 30d archival window. Recorded in spec.
2025-10-03 - Current blockers: audit-log schema v1 needs sign-off from Observability (ticket ENG-52412) before we can emit resolution traces to production sinks. Planning a joint sync 2025-10-06.
2025-10-03 - Next: finalize permissions matrix CSV, add test vectors for cross-tenant share scenarios, and prepare pilot migration plan for two internal tenants (infra-team and benchmark-team).
